_source: LOG.md (career journal), career save persistent.sfs, flight recorder. Game: KSP 1.12.5 career 'kspbot', Normal difficulty, all flying by Claude through kRPC + own KspBot mod, no autopilot mods. One real day: 2026-09-24.

career_now.funds_spent_on_facilities: MC2 75k, TS2 + Pad2, VAB2 225k, AC2, R&D2 451k

firsts: First crewed Minmus landing and return (Minmus Lander 1, Bill)
First crewed Mun landing and return (Mun Lander 3, Bob)
Two Minmus observational survey contracts (8 sites)
Minmus biome tour: Midlands, Greater Flats, Lesser Flats, Highlands (+ Great Flats, Lowlands earlier)
Every Minmus surface biome visited (Poles, Flats, Slopes on Mun Lander 7)
First rendezvous + Klaw grab: an uncrewed tanker refuelled Bob's stranded Mun lander in Mun orbit (Mun Tanker 1)
First relay satellite: Polar Relay 1 (RA-2) in a 1259 x 1883 km polar orbit, launch timed for the contract's LAN
First space station: Minmus Lab 1 (MPL-LG-2, Bob + Gwenbro) in a 14 km polar Minmus orbit, turning data into science

flyby + return, Jeb safe

FIRST CREWED MINMUS LANDING & RETURN (Bill)
fake pitch-over with ballast tank → flipped at max-Q. Jebediah killed (loss stands)

science without leaving the pad

FIRST CREWED MUN LANDING & RETURN (Bob)

temperature survey contract + Minmus landing (Jeb)
EVA on Minmus: lander broke apart as Jeb stepped out, Jeb flung at 1400 m/s
2 survey contracts, 4 new biomes, 1.28M funds; Jeb safe
landed at Minmus Poles; EVA flung Jeb off at 400 m/s onto an escape path and tipped the lander (the ML7 layout had worked in the sandbox)
polar orbit; landed at Poles, Flats and Slopes, so every Minmus surface biome is now visited; orbital EVA report; science 5.5 -> 247; Jeb safe

orbit science + orbital EVA report; landed in Lowlands, hopped to Farside Crater; the old liftoff made the hop cost 1434 m/s, leaving 891 m/s, short of the ~970 needed to fly home. Stranded, then rescued: lifted to a 35 km Mun orbit, refuelled by Mun Tanker 1 (#24), tanks rebalanced after an uneven fill spun the lander, flew home and splashed down; Bob safe; science 274

career_launches.goal: refuel Bob's stranded lander in Mun orbit
career_launches.note: uncrewed OKTO + Klaw + 2x FL-T400 + Terrier; first launch reverted (circularization tooling bug); relaunch to a retrograde 30 km Mun orbit; first career rendezvous (plane 18 m/s, intercept 9 + 25 m/s, held 28 m), Klaw grab, 292 LF / 358 Ox transferred, released; hulk left in Mun orbit

career_launches.goal: Minmus observational survey (4 low sites) + science tour with barometer, Science Jr and a storage unit
career_launches.note: survey sites capped at 5.1-7.1 km: periapsis dips aimed over each site (decompiled trigger range 7.75 km); landed Lowlands, Greater Flats, Midlands, Great Flats; one liftoff escaped Minmus (liftoff bug), quickloaded; all data collected into the storage unit and recovered: science 105 -> 670, funds 1.31M

career_launches.goal: uncrewed Klaw rescue of Beafrod from Kerbin orbit
career_launches.note: first launch seated Jeb by default (recovered; --crew none); the accepted contracts were lost because kRPC launched without saving, so Beafrod's cabin was empty; rendezvous 1.7 m/s intercept, stopped 8.6 m off, the 12 m stack swung at 4-16 deg/s during the grab and hit the cabin (no damage); released; first engine-first uncrewed reentry with the service module kept until 300 m, pod recovered

career_launches.goal: contract polar orbit (inc 90, LAN 205, 1259 x 1883 km) with RA-2 relay + Science Jr
career_launches.note: launch timed on the pad's inertial longitude (LAN 204.1 on arrival); first match-orbit: plane 198 + 489 + 573 m/s, periapsis came out 13 % low and the plane burn dipped it into the air; fixed with a 30 m/s periapsis burn; contract done, first relay satellite

career_launches.goal: Klaw-grab the contract's loose Thud (Module 761V7) in Minmus orbit and bring it home
career_launches.note: crewed (CommNet signal required); arrival flipped from retrograde to prograde with correct --inc-to (7.7 m/s); rendezvous held 28 m; hours of engine-only grab attempts bounced off, the Thud spun up to 160 deg/s (stopped with a moment of rails warp); raycast face maps; Jeb home, science 62.7 -> 95.2 -> RCS researched

a 90 deg plane change tuned itself onto a Minmus escape (cost ignored the orbit's energy) and a recovery burn went the wrong way (orbital_speed_at is wrong on a hyperbola); recaptured by a closed-loop retrograde burn; RCS held the Klaw square to the Thud's flat face within 0.03-0.09 m at 0.15 m/s, yet every contact bounced (0.5 m/s back) until the monopropellant ran out; Klaw diagnostics (KspBot GrappleDebug) show it armed and Ready; Jeb home

career_launches.goal: first Duna landing and return (orbit + surface science kept aboard, orbital EVA report)
career_launches.note: first launch reverted at Duna (arrival v_inf 1364 m/s: ejection sized for Duna's mean radius, the tuner twisted the path); relaunch v_inf 1037, elliptical capture 59 x 1007 km (539 m/s), orbit science + EVA report, land_atmo died at 28 km on a kRPC chute error -> emergency script, powered landing in the Midlands at 1.4 m/s; ~2800 m/s left, waiting 600 days for the Kerbin window

career_launches.goal: keosynchronous contract orbit (inc 34, e 0.10) with RA-2 relay
career_launches.note: launch timed into the plane (wait-plane); match-orbit 92 + 643 + 523 m/s; contract done; spent Kickbacks rode to 70 km (fixed)
match-orbit flipped it retrograde chasing a meaningless argPe; recovered with a bi-elliptic reversal (9,000 km apoapsis, 1150 m/s) and a capture burn; contract done

career_launches.goal: rescue Gwenbro (Mk1 Lander Can, LKO), engine-only Klaw craft
career_launches.note: rendezvous held 60 m; every square contact bounced; user: revert and use RCS
RCS held the Klaw square (0.03-0.07 m off-axis); 2 contacts bounced; orbit sank to 64.8 km unnoticed; reverted

found the Klaw bug: our .craft files had no MODULE nodes, so ModuleGrappleNode.OnLoad never ran and Grapple() threw a NullReferenceException on every contact (KSP.log); reloading the vessel fixed it: grabbed on the first contact; Gwenbro moved to the pod, splashdown, contract done; SRB thrust limit cut max Q 51 -> 36 kPa

career_launches.goal: rescue Mitbro from Minmus orbit (176 x 199 km, inc 21.5)
career_launches.note: first craft built with MODULE nodes: grabbed on the first contact without any reload; Mitbro moved to the pod with the new MoveCrew; the Dv gate refused the return burn because its own estimate was wrong (fixed); landed at night

career_launches.goal: Eve high/low orbit science + orbital EVA report per biome, return
career_launches.note: first live Lambert (broken-plane) transfer: 1027 m/s ejection, 372 m/s mid-course plane change, Eve pe 147 km as planned; aim-point seed turned the arrival 10 -> 73 deg for 69 m/s; 11 of 15 Eve biomes in orbital EVA reports over 7 periapsis passes; ~1017 sci aboard (no antenna reach from Eve); waiting for the return window

career_launches.goal: materials bay + goo + barometer in 5 Minmus biomes, collected into a storage unit
career_launches.note: Lowlands, Poles, Flats, Highlands, Lesser Flats, storage count checked after each; +1166 science on recovery (84 -> 1250). A failed EVA made eva report run every experiment in high space (5 Science Jrs, 6 goo): the stock Reset got them back. Return planner fixed (it chose a retrograde 229 m/s root over the prograde 164)

career_launches.goal: orbit-only science: Kerbin high, Mun and Minmus high/low, magnetometer, EVA report over every biome
career_launches.note: all 17 Mun and all 9 Minmus biomes in low-orbit EVA reports, magnetometer at 5 situations, first moon-to-moon transfer (Mun -> Minmus, waited 14 days for the polar orbit to line up); +1601 science (11 -> 1613); the pad EVA test dropped Bob onto the pad (reverted)

career_launches.goal: rescue Gwenbro (left behind by Rescue 3), Daphrick and Jedgard from LKO in one flight
career_launches.note: Mk1-3 pod with a Klaw; the first grab caught Rescue 3's empty can of the same name; three first-contact grabs, all three crew home; two rescue contracts done

career_launches.goal: science station: Mobile Processing Lab with two scientists in a low polar Minmus orbit
career_launches.note: two pad topples (a kerbal leaving the MPL kicks the stack) and one ascent flip (no fins once the Mainsail dropped) were reverted; the HG-55 wasn't extended, so the probe core lost control at Minmus; all 9 Minmus biome EVA reports + gravity scans; lab 720/750 data, first 143 sci transmitted

career_launches.goal: keosynchronous satellite with a gravioli detector and a thermometer (contract)
career_launches.note: Keo Relay 2 with a gravimeter; match-orbit 13 + 647 + 457 m/s, all elements within 0.1 %; 4617 m/s left as a spare relay

bugs_found_and_fixed_fun: ascent autopilot flew nose-down at full thrust (Orbiter 1)
SRB stack 0.4° off axis = 26 kN·m torque vs a 5 kN·m wheel
autostrut on side boosters → explosion at t=0
kRPC biome lookup wants radians, not degrees → every biome-targeted landing looked at the wrong spot
Communotron antenna never unfolded → science 'transmitted' silently failed
survey waypoints accepted mid-flight don't count until a scene reload
kRPC launches straight into flight without saving: contracts accepted at the space center came back as 'offered', the rescue kerbal vanished, the advances stayed
`eva report` after a failed EVA ran every experiment on the ship; the stock Reset saved the single-use ones
the moon-return tuner happily picked the retrograde root: 65 m/s more and a hotter entry
a kerbal climbing out of the science lab kicks the whole 87 t rocket hard enough to knock it off the launch pad
